Embeddings:
node 0: [1,0]
node 1: [0,1]
node 2: [0,0]
node 3: [0,0]
node 4: [0,0]
node 5: [1,0]
node 6: [1,1]
node 7: [0,0]
node 8: [0,0]
node 9: [0,1]
node 10: [0,1]
node 11: [1,1]
The edges are: (0,6) (0,11) (1,4) (2,6) (2,4) (2,10) (2,7) (3,10) (3,7) (4,9) (5,11) (6,10) (7,8) (7,10) (8,11) (9,11)
In a simple graph convolution layer, each node's embedding is updated by the sum of its neighbors' embeddings.
Q: What's the embedding of each node after one layer of simple graph convolution layer?
A:

Return only a JSON object using this schema: {"node_embeddings":{"0":[0,0]}}
